*Source: [The Catgirl Handbook](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/352302/The-Catgirl-Handbook?affiliate_id=549120)*

Still a musician at heart, a purrsician is a special kind of cat which can take their purring to the next level as symphony of the warm tones. Purrsicians are otherwise still very much classically trained bards and possess many of the same skills as their colleagues but choose to take advantage of their natural capabilities rather than relying on an instrument.

## Purrfessional (Ex)

At 1st level, the purrsician does not gain any bardic performance types but still gains bardic performance rounds as normal which they may use with bardic masterpieces and other abilities.

Instead of gaining bardic performances, the purrsician gains a bonus purring feat at 1st level and every odd level thereafter. If the purrsician would select a purring feat they already possess this way, they may immediately retrain that purring feat at no additional cost in money or time, selecting a new, valid feat or other choice for that feat (such as retraining a feat gained with level advancement to another valid feat).

This ability alters bardic performance and replaces each bardic performance type.

## Caterwauling (Ex)

The purrsician’s purring is able to stir their allies into a fervor. At 2nd level, the purrsician and their allies within their purring aura gain a +1 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls. This bonus increases at 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

## Expansive Purring (Ex)

The purrsician’s is able to naturally project the vibrations of their purring, reaching further than normally possible. At 3rd level, when determining the radius of their purring aura, the purrsician increases the radius of their purring aura by +5 feet for each purring feat they possess (instead of +5 feet for every two purring feats).

## Cat Of Renown

As the purrsician grows in fame and skill, they begin to pick up new skills and tricks to be worthy of this renown. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the purrsician gains one rogue talent or vigilante social talent, using their bard level as their rogue or vigilante level respectively when determining their effects and for the purposes of qualifying for rogue talent and vigilante social talent prerequisites. Beginning at 10th level, the purrsician may also select from advanced rogue talents.
